description: One bounded monitoring check of an entity: the current fingerprint of its core facts (country, headquarters, website, CEO, employees, revenue, population, version ... by kind), changed true or false against the fingerprint you kept, the facts that differ from YRUZ's previous observation, and the source's latest revision. No subscription: each check is one paid call. Price: 0.003 USDC per call, paid with x402 (USDC on Base or Solana, no account, no API key); invalid input is refused before payment and a failed run is never charged. Without a payment the tool returns the x402 PaymentRequired. How to call it: get_example {"tool":"reality_monitor_check"}. Same tool over HTTP: https://yruz.one/api/reality/monitor?id=Q7624104

fingerprint.description: fingerprint returned by your previous check (optional)
